searchText: Hi :) I wonder is there is anything specific for the genesis slot in terms of block proposals - it should be treated just like any other slot, correct? Perhaps this has been discussed before somewhere in some channel...? there are no proposals at genesis slot but attestations happen the genesis slot has a pre-defined genesis block
